subject: Activation handoff: EchoHealth pilot & SOW items
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sara Holden <sara@echohealth.com>, Matt Evans <matt.evans@echohealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: EchoHealth pilot — next steps & handoff to success

Hi Sara / Matt — great to be crossing the finish line on signature. Quick note to introduce our CS team and outline next steps so we can hit the agreed pilot kickoff on July 6.

Attachments: EchoHealth_SOW_v3.pdf (redlined SOW), pilot_acceptance_criteria.xlsx

Summary/ask: please confirm that procurement has the signed SOW (I’ve attached final PDF) and that the PO will be sent by 6/28 so we can begin environment provisioning. We will hand the operational lead to Hannah for scheduling and Tessa for acceptance criteria; Monica will be the technical onboarding contact.

Key items we will track during handoff:
- Pilot scope: 3 teams, up to 10k inference calls/day, integration via API keys
- Data residency: US-only region (confirmed)
- Network: customer-managed VPC peering & KMS for keys — action from EchoHealth network team required before 6/30
- Success metric: average p95 latency <450ms for 95% of requests and qualitative NPS >=7 after 30 days

Next steps I’ll take today: share the SOW & acceptance sheet in Drive (link below) and open a kickoff calendar hold for July 6 10:00-11:00 PT. Please loop in your network/security contact if they need to be on the call.

Thanks everyone — excited to get this running.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri+echo@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Sara Holden <sara@echohealth.com>

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EchoHealth pilot — next steps & handoff to success

Hi Priyom — thanks for the clear summary and for attaching the doc. I’ve forwarded the SOW to Procurement; they asked for a final PDF with signature page and our vendor onboarding packet (I attached our packet to this reply).

Two quick clarifications before the kickoff: 
1) On the VPC peering, our network lead (Matt) will need the CIDR and hostname list — can you confirm the timing for when those will be provided?
2) On the rollout, can we scope a short smoke test (1000 calls) for the first 48 hours rather than opening to all teams at once? That helps us validate traffic shaping.

We’ll aim to get the PO to you by 6/28; if procurement has questions I’ll loop you in.

Cheers,
Sara
VP Product Operations | EchoHealth
S: 973-555-9988

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Holden <sara@echohealth.com>, Matt Evans <matt.evans@echohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: EchoHealth handoff — owners & risks

Hannah / Monica / Tessa — tagging you to take primary ownership for the activation once PO is in. Copying the external thread below for context. Key notes and recommended plan: 

Context: mid-sized healthtech customer, committed to a 30-day pilot, target production ramp if pilot passes. Deal ID HB-3382. Regional restriction: US-only. Engineering will do API integration. 

Assigned owners: 
- Primary CS owner / kickoff lead: Hannah Schmitt (please book July 6 kickoff and create agenda)
- Technical onboarding & VPC lead: Monica Patel (you’ll drive the VPC peering checklist and KMS exchange)
- Acceptance criteria & QA owner: Tessa Morgan (validate the acceptance spreadsheet and run the smoke test plan)

Risks / open blockers: 
1) Procurement timeline — PO expected by 6/28; if delayed, push provisioning by 1 week and inform customer.
2) Network window — customer team requires CIDR/hostnames for peering; need to provide by 6/23 to meet provisioning window.
3) Quota & model selection — recommended default model: redwood-llm-qa-v2 (quantized) for pilot to keep costs predictable. If usage spikes, plan fallback to smaller model.

Action items I’ll take today:
- Share SOW final PDF signed copy to Procurement (done).
- Upload both docs to shared drive and add HubSpot note (links below).

Please reply-all to confirm you own these items and whether you need any pre-kickoff support from Sales/Eng.

Thanks — Priyom
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Holden <sara@echohealth.com>, Matt Evans <matt.evans@echohealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@echohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: EchoHealth handoff — owners & risks

Thanks Priyom — I’ll take the kickoff lead. I have blocked July 6 10:00-11:00 PT on all calendars and drafted an agenda: introductions, scope & SOW walk, network prerequisites, access & API keys, pilot monitoring plan, acceptance criteria review, and next meeting cadence.

Monica — can you start the VPC checklist and share the CIDR/hostname requirements for EchoHealth by end of day 6/23? I’ll reach out to Sara to confirm procurement cadence and ensure we get the PO in time.

Tessa — I’ll send the pilot_acceptance_criteria.xlsx to the customer for review and propose the 1k/48hr smoke test as step 1. If procurement delays beyond 6/28 we’ll shift provisioning to the week of 7/6 and keep the kickoff but mark it as planning-only.

I’ll update HubSpot and add the kickoff agenda doc to the drive folder. Priyom — feel free to drop any internal notes you want persisted in the HubSpot timeline.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
